    height = observation.get('height', 10)

    def is_valid(pos):

    def get_closest(targets):

            t_x = t.get('x', 0)
            t_y = t.get('y', 0)
            dist = abs(t_x - my_x) + abs(t_y - my_y)
            if dist < min_dist:
                min_dist = dist
                dx = t_x - my_x

                # Normalize to -1, 0, 1
                dx = 0 if dx == 0 else (1 if dx > 0 else -1)
                dy = 0 if dy == 0 else (1 if dy > 0 else -1)
                dir_x, dir_y = dx, dy
        if min_dist == float('inf'):

        return dir_x, dir_y

    # Priority 1: Collect resources if available
    if resources:
        direction = get_closest(resources)
        if direction:
            dx, dy = direction
            new_x = my_x + dx
            new_y = my_y + dy
            if is_valid((new_x, new_y)):

    # Priority 2: Pursue closest enemy if resource not available
    if enemies:

            dx, dy = direction
            new_x = my_x + dx
            new_y = my_y + dy
            if is_valid((new_x, new_y)):

    # Priority 3: Defensive movement - stay in place or move randomly if no targets

    center_x, center_y = width // 2, height // 2
    dx = 0
    if my_x < center_x:

    elif my_x > center_x:

    dy = 0

    # Fallback: stay in place
